# Precise-rung independent confirmation: source shortlist

Status: source-backed proposal only. This file does not freeze inputs or authorize PubMed retrieval. The first comparison's R01–R06 cases, B. fragilis example and SARS diagnostic are excluded. Sources were selected from primary article abstracts/full text through read-only pages, without calling the maintained retrieval tool, NCBI API, or a model. A source researcher briefly saw broad prior-outcome prose while locating files but did not use result lists to select cases; the independent preregistration must retain that limitation.

| Domain | Proposed positive claim and target | Distinct control claim and anchor | Why paired / risk |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Synapse elimination | Postnatal neuronal C1q and C3 mark inappropriate retinogeniculate synapses for elimination; deficient mice retain excess retinal inputs. [Stevens et al., 2007, PMID 18083105](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/18083105/), DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2007.10.036. | Developing astrocytes engulf synapses through MEGF10/MERTK; double-deficient mice fail to refine retinogeniculate connections. [Chung et al., 2013, PMID 24270812](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3969024/), DOI 10.1038/nature12776. | Same circuit, different complement versus astrocytic phagocytosis mechanisms; substantial vocabulary overlap. |
| Chitin immunity | Arabidopsis CERK1 is required for chitin-triggered MAPK, reactive oxygen and defense-gene responses and contributes to Alternaria resistance. [Miya et al., 2007, PMID 18042724](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2148337/), DOI 10.1073/pnas.0705147104. | Rice CEBiP binds chitin oligosaccharides; its knockdown reduces chitin-triggered oxidative/defense responses while preserving lipopolysaccharide response. [Kaku et al., 2006, PMID 16829581](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC1636686/), DOI 10.1073/pnas.0508882103. | Different species and receptor roles with shared chitin/LysM terms; Miya's abstract mentions CEBiP. |
| T6SS competition | Vibrio cholerae TseH outcompetes otherwise resistant E. coli under magnesium/calcium supplementation, with PhoPQ mediating magnesium sensitivity. [Tang et al., 2022, PMID 35354946](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9213406/), DOI 10.1038/s41396-022-01228-5. | Pseudomonas aeruginosa H1-T6SS exports Tse2, which suppresses recipient proliferation; cognate Tsi2 protects the producer. [Hood et al., 2010, PMID 20114026](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2831478/), DOI 10.1016/j.chom.2009.12.007. | Shared secretion-system topic, different organism/effector; avoid claiming direct cytoplasmic delivery, which Hood et al. did not establish. |

Before any call, freeze exact queries and scoring IDs in a new preregistration, keep a separate key-free runner input, and commit an authorization amendment only after code, build, trace and process receipts are verified. The joint rule must require valid provenance and declared primary/non-regression success in both the completed exploratory comparison and confirmation. A completed gate failure rejects the narrow candidate; incomplete or inconclusive work remains open. The isolated algorithm is not deployed.
